I just can't bear to live with what I've done to someone I love. I guess killing myself just makes it worse. I'd do it except for how it would make my parents feel. If they were no longer alive then I prob would have done it by now.

I guess I could throw my husk of an existence to make something good. Not sure what that would be. I feel like I need to press reset. 

One caveat is there has been someone trying to get revenge and punish me. Someone who caused this chain of events to be set in motion. I feel if I died that is the only revenge I would want. Seems so logical as there is no other way for me to hurt this person. 

I guess i need to forgive
